say:1:1130417001:1.text: The summit is reserved for the victors of the Warsong Festival.
say:1:1130417001:1.source_cn: 只有在战歌节中获胜的强者才能登上顶峰。
say:1:1130417001:1.male: The summit is reserved for the victors of the Warsong Festival.
say:1:1130417001:1.female: The summit is reserved for the victors of the Warsong Festival.

say:2:1130417002:1.text: And the Dusk Lord will choose the ultimate champion from among them!
say:2:1130417002:1.source_cn: 而残阳神会在其中选出真正的勇士！
say:2:1130417002:1.male: And the Dusk Lord will choose the ultimate champion from among them!
say:2:1130417002:1.female: And the Dusk Lord will choose the ultimate champion from among them!

say:3:1130417003:1.text: It's clear from where I stand that you possess great strength. Whether the Dusk Lord deems you worthy is another matter entirely.
say:3:1130417003:1.source_cn: 依我看，你们确实很强，但我不确定你们能否被残阳神选中。
say:3:1130417003:1.male: It's clear from where I stand that you possess great strength. Whether the Dusk Lord deems you worthy is another matter entirely.
say:3:1130417003:1.female: It's clear from where I stand that you possess great strength. Whether the Dusk Lord deems you worthy is another matter entirely.
